The following Minimum Quantification Levels (MQL's) are to be used for reporting pollutant
data for NPDES permit applications and/or compliance reporting.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The phrase 'permit applications and/or compliance reporting' is scope-ambiguous: if MQLs bind only application reporting, they may not govern FY2025 compliance-period limit comparisons (A), reporting obligations tied to compliance monitoring (B), or classification of sub-quantification/no-result cases during compliance (C); if they bind compliance reporting, all three computations incorporate these thresholds.

The segment header locates this text under Section part_i while the body identifies it as Appendix A of Part II; different readings of which permit part/appendix governs could change whether these MQL values are the operative standards for limit comparison (A), applicable reporting/monitoring context (B), and missing-evidence handling (C).

MQL values are denominated in µg/l; if reported measurements or enforceable limits use different units, conversion or unit-mismatch resolution changes which numeric comparison applies and whether a measurement is treated as exceeding the applicable limit.

Two distinct Mercury MQL values appear with only a '*1' marker and no footnote text in this segment; selecting 0.0005 versus 0.005 changes the quantification threshold used when comparing mercury results to limits (A) and when classifying mercury results as quantified, below quantification, or missing-evidence (C).
